Let me blow the dust off the DCG topic here...... ok better 

I was attempting two color DCG holography this weekend and wanted to ask a question that was most likely discussed already. 

In my attempt to dial in the color in both green and blue wavelengths, I ended up shooting a blue only and a green only holo of the same object. The holo made with blue was noticeabily noiseier than than of green. Noise to me in this case (and maybe I'm using the wrong word) is a scattering of light, even a blochiness on the surface of the plate if the replay light is just right. Can anyone please explain this again? Is it an issue of the light bouncing inside the glass? Any suggestions of a cure?

Oddly, I don't seem to see this as much when I shoot flat coins. I normally shot coins to verify my film is good and the same as the previos batch.
